verdict.rationale: Evidence shows New Relic ships an MCP *server* so external AI tools can query New Relic data (docs-11, docs-22, docs-36, probe-3), but this is the server/provider role, not the product acting as an MCP *client* that ingests external MCP servers' tools into its own AI assistant (New Relic AI). No evidence describes such client-side MCP plugin capability.
